msg: The gnomes will always appear in fixed pairs. Orange and brown, green and pink, red and yellow, and blue and purple. Their size or hat etc, and whether they are on the right or left is irrelevant.  The most important thing to know is that each colour corresponds to either a red or yellow basket.Orange, green, red and blue will take you to the red basket.Brown, pink, yellow and purple will take you to the yellow basket.Initially you need to find the basket that yields the most mushrooms (usually 5+) and just keep going to that colour. When the yield begins to fall (4 or lower) switch to the other colour to see if the yield is better (sometimes it isn't).Whether yellow or red is better will change from time to time so if the yield is lower than 4 for one basket just keep switching until you find a 5+ and then stick with it. Rinse and repeat.
